title: Integrasi Visualisasi Data Grid Real-Time dengan Perspective
instructions:
# J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. - Software Engineering Lite
## Task 2: Live Perspective Data Grid & Stream Processor

### Business Context
Traders on the desk require a dynamic, real-time visual interface to monitor price discrepancies between correlated stock symbols in real-time.

### Technical Requirements
1. Implement a real-time data feeding server and client utility using Python.
2. Ingest continuous mock tick streams containing `stock`, `top_ask_price`, `top_bid_price`, and `timestamp`.
3. Aggregate quotes into a Perspective-ready data structure containing computed fields (`price`, `ratio`, `upper_bound`, `lower_bound`, `trigger_alert`).
4. Write comprehensive unit test suites verifying streaming throughput, aggregation logic, and alert threshold detection.
5. Include production-ready README.md explaining architecture, latency considerations, and step-by-step verification.
senior_commit: feat(jpmorgan-grid): implementasi processor agregasi data tick-by-tick dan visualisasi Perspective

title: Normalisasi & Pipeline Ingesti Data Telemetri IIoT Pabrik
instructions:
# Deloitte - Technology Consulting
## Task 1: Daikibo Industrials IIoT Telemetry Ingestion Pipeline

### Business Context
Daikibo Industrials operates manufacturing plants across 4 continents. Telemetry sensors on production lines stream temperatures, vibration frequencies, and error codes in fragmented legacy JSON and CSV formats.

### Technical Requirements
1. Build an ETL ingestion module that parses heterogeneous telemetry streams from factory floor sensors.
2. Normalize timestamps into UTC ISO-8601, clean corrupted sensor anomalies, and validate data contracts.
3. Calculate statistical moving averages, anomaly detection flags (temperatures > 3 sigma above baseline), and machine health scores.
4. Provide 100% test coverage with pytest/unittest testing edge cases (corrupt inputs, schema drift, sensor dropouts).
5. Document data flow architecture, schema definition, and production deployment notes in README.md.
senior_commit: feat(deloitte-iiot): rancang pipeline ETL normalisasi telemetri pabrik dan deteksi anomali multi-sensor

title: Refactoring Arsitektur Komponen Mesin & Sistem Servis Armada Lyft
instructions:
# Lyft - Backend Engineering
## Task: Clean Architecture & Strategy Pattern Refactoring for Fleet Maintenance

### Business Context
Lyft's rental car fleet management service needs a modular refactor to handle different engine types (Capulet, Willoughby, Sternman) and battery/tire inspection rules across different vehicle models without tightly coupled inheritance.

### Technical Requirements
1. Design and implement a clean, extensible object-oriented architecture utilizing the Strategy and Factory patterns.
2. Decouple Engine, Battery, and Car components with clear interfaces (`Engine`, `Battery`, `Serviceable`).
3. Implement service criteria: mileage-based triggers, calendar-based intervals, and sensor wear thresholds.
4. Write robust unit tests verifying servicing logic for all car models (Calliope, Glissando, Palindrome, Rorschach, Thovex).
5. Author an in-depth README.md detailing architectural design decisions, UML diagram in text/markdown, and extensibility guidelines.
senior_commit: refactor(lyft-core): decoupling arsitektur servis armada armada berbasis Factory & Strategy pattern

title: Implementasi Struktur Data K-Ary Heap untuk Optimasi Antrean Logistik
instructions:
# Walmart Global Tech - Advanced Software Engineering
## Task: High-Performance Multi-way Heap for Real-time Warehouse Logistics

### Business Context
Walmart distribution centers process millions of package fulfillment requests per hour. The existing binary priority queue suffers from cache-miss bottlenecks under heavy multi-core loads.

### Technical Requirements
1. Implement a generic, high-performance Power-of-Two (2^k-ary) Min-Heap / Max-Heap data structure from scratch in Python.
2. Optimize branch prediction and cache-line locality for push/pop/peek operations compared to standard binary heaps.
3. Implement a priority-based order dispatch simulation simulating thousands of simultaneous package arrivals and truck loading events.
4. Provide benchmark test suites comparing time complexity, memory footprint, and operations-per-second against standard `heapq`.
5. Write technical README.md detailing algorithmic complexity analysis, mathematical proof of child-parent indices, and profiling results.
senior_commit: perf(walmart-logistik): implementasi k-ary priority heap berkinerja tinggi untuk optimasi antrean fulfillment

title: Audit Keamanan Kriptografis & Pipeline Verifikasi Hash Kredensial
instructions:
# Goldman Sachs - Engineering Division
## Task: Cryptographic Verification & Credential Security Audit Pipeline

### Business Context
Following a security assessment of legacy internal systems, engineering teams must identify weak password hashing schemes (MD5/SHA1 without salt) and migrate credentials safely to modern standards (Argon2 / PBKDF2 / bcrypt).

### Technical Requirements
1. Implement a security auditor module that analyzes credential databases for cryptographic entropy and vulnerable hashing patterns.
2. Implement a secure password upgrade pipeline that re-hashes passwords transparently during authentication.
3. Simulate brute-force/dictionary collision resilience testing for audited algorithms.
4. Include unit tests covering edge cases: salt collision resistance, timing attack mitigation, and constant-time string comparison.
5. Document security threat models, remediation guidelines, and compliance standards (NIST SP 800-63B) in README.md.
senior_commit: sec(goldman-audit): implementasi pipeline migrasi kriptografis kredensial dan mitigasi timing-attack

title: Pipeline Pemrosesan Data & Analisis Kategori Konten Media Sosial
instructions:
# Accenture - Data Analytics & Strategy
## Task: Social Buzz Content Engagement & Sentiment Analytics Pipeline

### Business Context
A rapidly growing social media client (Social Buzz) needs actionable insights from 7 disparate datasets (Reactions, Content, ReactionTypes) totaling over 100,000 interactions to guide their IPO strategy.

### Technical Requirements
1. Build an automated data cleaning and harmonization pipeline that handles missing values, inconsistent categories, and outliers.
2. Merge relational datasets using appropriate join strategies (`content_id`, `reaction_type`).
3. Calculate aggregate engagement scores across content categories and rank top 5 performing segments.
4. Output structured analytical summaries in CSV and JSON formats, ready for executive reporting.
5. Write unit tests validating data integrity post-transformation, and document executive insights in README.md.
senior_commit: feat(accenture-bi): otomatisasi pipeline agregasi metrik engagement multi-dataset dan pemodelan kategori
